programme.desc: Jorge es un joven rebelde que no respeta a su madre. Un día se mete en problemas por culpa de su novia. Pero la vida le da una gran lección al perder a su abuela, la única persona que siempre lo apoyó incluso para que él naciera.

programme.title: Como dice el dicho
programme.desc: Don Tomás sufre un infarto y despierta en un hospital, el señor que lo llevó le dice que es su hijo y le reclama por abandonarlo a él y a su madre. Pero pronto, Isabel descubre que todo es mentira.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Roberta platica con José y le dice que Gastón la odia, ella cree que fue una carga muy grande y por eso está enojado. Alma dona toda la ropa de Roberta a una casa hogar.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Gastón es buscado por la policía y cree que José fue quien los llamó. Mía le pone una trampa a Sol para que deje de usar su perfume. Teo y Miguel van con la policía a casa de Gastón. Miguel quiere impedir que Gastón se vaya.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Gastón se encuentra grave en el hospital y recibe la visita de Enrique, quien aprovecha para pedirle un favor. Miguel encuentra a Franco y Alma besándose, pero ellos le piden que no le diga nada a Roberta y a Mía. José tiene miedo que Gastón muera.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: León investiga a Diego y se da cuenta de que le ha estado mintiendo. Sin querer, Sol descubre que Franco y Alma son novios. El director hace una junta para decidir quién ocupará el puesto de Gastón. Jose está muy triste por la muerte de Gastón.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Diego decide salirse del grupo porque su padre no acepta que sea cantante. Los chicos tratan de convencerlo, pero él está decidido. José platica con Lola y le dice que es doloroso ser huérfana.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: El profesor Enrique habla con Diego y le dice que podrá viajar a la gira en Los Ángeles. Diego le cuenta a Roberta que podrá ir con ellos a la gira. Mía se entera por un mensaje anónimo que su papá sale con Alma, ella cree que todo es mentira.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Pilar cuestiona a Tomás sobre Celeste; Roberta admira a Diego por enfrentar a su papá; León intenta que Franco y Alma no dejen ir a sus hijas al concierto; Celeste va al Elite a visitar a Giovanni; los papás de Lola le dicen la verdad de su origen.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: La banda planea su gira por Los Ángeles y todos están entusiasmados. Mía pelea con Miguel en el ensayo porque está celosa de Sabrina. Franco le da permiso a Mía para irse de viaje con Miguel.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Max le dice a Celina que está enamorado de ella. Pilar le exige a Giovanni que le explique sobre su enfermedad. Celina recibe la visita de su mamá, la cual la hace sentir mal por su sobrepeso. León decide castigar a Diego por seguir en la banda.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: RBD da un show en Los Ángeles, California. Alma apoya nuevos talentos musicales. Santos le manda una rosa con dedicatoria a Lupita. Gastón le escribe una carta a Luján antes de morir. RBD regresa de gira con un gran anuncio.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Roberta lee la carta que dejó Gastón. Javier se sincera con Roberta para que pueda volver a confiar en él, pero ella se decepciona más y lo abofetea. Después de ver casas, Mía le dice a su papá que ya sabe sobre su relación con Alma.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Miguel se alegra al descubrir que no tuvo intimidad con Sabrina. Roberta se pelea con Mía por llamar a Alma mentirosa. Madariaga le entrega a José una carta que le dejó Gastón antes de morir. Roberta se enoja con Martín y decide huir a casa de Alma.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Mía experimenta un conflicto por la relación de Franco y Alma. Mía habla con Alma sobre la relación que tiene con su papá y le exige que no salga con él. Miguel le reclama a Sabrina por hacerle creer a Mía que pasaron la noche juntos.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: La mamá de Celina no la deja entrar a la boda de su hermana, al igual que a Vico, porque se avergüenza de ella, pero su novio la consuela y experimentan algo que no habían hecho antes. Se alistan los permisos para grabar el disco de RBD.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Se alista la grabación del disco de RBD. Roberta se pone muy triste porque extraña a Alma, pero no puede perdonarla por tanta soledad que sintió cuando era niña, así que Martín la consuela. Mía confronta a Alma y Franco frente a Roberta.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Tras una artimaña de León, Reverte es despedido del colegio y Roberta les confiesa a sus compañeros que el profesor es su padre. Se hace una fiesta de despedida para Reverte y Miguel sufre un desmayo, es llevado al hospital y cae en estado de coma.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Mía llora desesperada porque Miguel puede morir. León amenaza con destruir la carrera de Alma Rey si no saca a Roberta de la escuela. Raquel desenmascara las mentiras de Sol y le afirma que nunca podrá ser una top model por su estatura.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: León influye en los directivos de la escuela para expulsar a Roberta. Diego decide dejar la banda para proteger a Roberta de su papá. Mía se siente orgullosa de Franco y le pregunta si Miguel algún día abrirá los ojos.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Roberta, Diego y Martín Reverte arman un plan para que León sea encarcelado por los fraudes que cometió, pero León los descubre y lo impide. Alma llama a León para informarle que un amigo de ella tiene información comprometedora sobre él.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Alma le exige a León que reincorporen a Roberta y al profesor Reverte al colegio a cambio de unos papeles que lo comprometen. Madariaga informa a los muchachos que si Miguel entra en un estado crítico y despierta puede tener daño cerebral.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Diego le deja en claro a León que puede cuidarse solo y no necesita de su dinero. Mía cuida a Miguel mientras se encuentra en coma, pero cuando él abre los ojos, no la reconoce. José, finalmente, lee la carta que le dejó Gastón.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Miguel despierta del coma, pero no recuerda nada, excepto a Diego. Diego intenta ayudar a Miguel para que recuerde. Mía se altera mucho porque Miguel no la recuerda. Los alumnos comienzan a buscar universidad.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Vico le dice a Celina que Giovanni ya sabe sobre la prueba de embarazo, algo que preocupa a Vico y Celina, ya que no quieren que nadie sepa. Marina intenta saber quién le llamó misteriosamente al hotel y llama al celular de Alma.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Todos se enteran de que Celina está embarazada. Alma Rey habla con la mamá de Mía y Franco se enoja por meterse en sus asuntos. Mía piensa seguir los consejos de Alma y Lupita en torno a Miguel.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Celina no sabe qué hacer con su bebé, se siente muy sola porque Max se fue y el profesor Madariaga la aconseja. Sol se entera del embarazo, chantajea a Celina y a sus amigas. Alma no cree en las intenciones de Marina de no acercarse a Mía.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Celina asiste a su primera cita médica. Marina le pide perdón a Franco por haberlo abandonado. Miguel le pide a Mía que le ayude a recordar sobre su novia, pero él cree que su novia es Sabrina. Diego es despedido de su trabajo por culpa de su padre.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Mía no perdona a Franco por mentirle toda su vida sobre el presunto fallecimiento de su madre. Miguel no acepta hacer la rehabilitación y Franco habla con él. Javier es inculpado en el robo de tangas y calzones a las alumnas de Elite Way.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Gandía le confiesa la verdad a Madariaga sobre las amenazas de León para que aceptara entrar en sus negocios; Mía quiere localizar a su mamá, pero Franco le dice que desapareció de nuevo; Miguel le pregunta a Diego y Roberta si Mía era su novia.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Mía pone un anuncio en el periódico para localizar a su mamá; Pascual se niega a desafiar a León por no perder su empleo; León manda a secuestrar a Diego para utilizarlo como un golpe publicitario para su campaña; Mía y Marina se encuentran.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Roberta termina su noviazgo con Diego por aceptar los chantajes de León. Marina le explica a Mía por qué se fue. Gandía se niega a renunciar al colegio. Mía planea irse a vivir con su mamá.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Mía le pide permiso a Franco para irse a vivir con Marina, si las cosas salen bien. Sol, bajo el nombre de Vico, le informa a la mamá de Celina que su hija está embarazada. Celina le dice a su mamá que se va a casar con Max.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Franco le ofrece la patria potestad de Mía a Marina. Giovanni se hace pasar por gay para engañar al papá de Javier. Roberta acepta a Colucci como la pareja de su mamá. Miguel busca hablar con Mía para reconciliarse.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Mía perdona a su papá. Marina le promete a Mía salir de sus adicciones. León es detenido acusado de malos manejos. Mía le ruega a Miguel que no se vaya a Monterrey porque lo ama. Diego le dice a Roberta que la ama.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Franco y Alma se casan, José les agradece aceptarla en su familia. Diego y Roberta se reconcilian. Miguel le pide a Mía que se case con él. Pascual clausura el curso. Roberta les dice a todos que RBD seguirá.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Mía se queda sin vacaciones por hacer un striptease. Por su parte, Diego sufre un accidente por conducir ebrio. Roberta es obligada a estudiar en la Elite Way School.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Roberta intenta no ser admitida en el colegio. Por su parte, Miguel deja Monterrey, y se le dificulta presentar su examen de admisión en la Elite Way School. Además, Lupita puede estudiar gracias a su tía.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Mayra ayuda a Miguel a entrar a la escuela. Miguel, Lupita y Nico hacen su examen para entrar a la escuela. Por su parte, los chicos de cuarto año se van de viaje a Vallarta.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Roberta casi se ahoga y Mauro la salva. Diego va a una iglesia a hacer servicio comunitario y un tipo lo golpea.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Roberta y Mía se pelean por el profesor. Pero la que termina ganando la pelea es Alma, la mamá de Roberta.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Miguel amenaza a Mía por humillar a Celina. Diego intenta vengarse de la persona que lo agredió, pero su padre interviene entregando al matón a la Policía. Roberta, movida por los celos, insulta a Alma.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: El papá de Mía llega al Vacance Club y conoce a Miguel. Mientras tanto, Diego se pone muy borracho y Mía lo ayuda. Alma y Franco se conocen en la carretera.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Miguel le pide a Celina que sea su novia. Por su parte, Alma le manda un arreglo de Flores a Franco para agradecerle. En plan de hacerse la vida imposible, Diego empuja a Roberta al lago y ella casi se ahoga.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Mía le pide a Franco una foto de su madre. Diego amenaza a Roberta, pero León los interrumpe. Miguel se acerca a Franco con el pretexto de pedirle una entrevista para una tarea. Nico se golpea la cabeza peleando con Miguel tras insultarlo.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Lupita ya no quiere compartir la habitación con Roberta. Toda esta situación hace que Roberta se sienta discriminada por los chicos del colegio.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Celina le advierte a Lupita que se aleje de Miguel; Roberta comprueba que no es una ladrona; Diego es humillado frente a todos; León le regala un automóvil al director; Roberta inventa que Franco acosa a Alma; Mía fotografía a Lupita y Miguel juntos.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Franco se enfurece al saber que lo culpan de acosar sexualmente a Alma y amenaza con demandarla; Pilar acusa a su padre de corrupto; Roberta insiste en entrar al grupo coreográfico; Alma recibe una llamada del abogado de Franco.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Mía no puede evitar soñar con Miguel y se imagina besándolo. Roberta le confiesa a su madre que se inventó el chisme de su acosador. Tomás cree que Pilar es su admiradora. Miguel se presenta a la madre de Celina como su novio.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Fabián le cede a Marcelino a Roberta; Vico llega a la fiesta de Diego y lo abofetea por no invitarla; en un programa de televisión, Alma acepta que Franco nunca la acosó sexualmente; Vico es quien intenta seducir a Tomás.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Roberta insiste en entrar al grupo de baile; Miguel se enoja con Celina por celosa; Franco descubre que Miguel le mintió y el director quiere sancionarlo; José ayuda a Roberta a ocultar a Marcelino; Miguel miente y recupera la confianza de Franco.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Roberta logra formar su grupo coreográfico. Franco investiga a Miguel y su apellido se le hace familiar. Pilar escribe sobre Giovanni en sus anónimos y él la amenaza. Diego descubre que Roberta esconde a un niño. Mía enfrenta a Miguel y la besa.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Mía y Miguel pactan una tregua y fingen no gustarse; culpan a Lupita de chismosa; el director descubre al niño que esconde y Roberta lo saca del colegio; Roberta lee su ensayo sobre Diego; Miguel encuentra un papel con la marca de la logia.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Miguel es elegido por la logia; José es mordido por uno de los perros de León por evitar que encuentre a Marcelino; Mía sospecha que Vico oculta algo; Lupita se va del colegio por lo que dicen de ella.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Mía y Roberta van a buscar a Lupita. La logia cita a Miguel en el sótano de la escuela y lo torturan para que acepte dejar la escuela.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Los chicos se escapan del colegio para ir a una fiesta que organizó Roberta en un antro. Roberta y Diego se besan.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: Martina está muy emocionada en el día de su boda: quiere que todo sea perfecto y la Nena la ayudará. El final será totalmente inesperado.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: Martina quedó deprimida porque su amado "Muffin Love" la dejó plantada en el hogar, pero la familia la ayuda a superar la tristeza. La Nena se aburre porque Martina no tiene ganas de pelea.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: Plácido está muy nervioso porque Martina piensa que va a dar a luz a un par de gemelos. Renata, Licha, Nena y Gaby tratan de introducir a Martina en el complejo mundo de la maternidad.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: Gaby consigue trabajo como guía de turismo, y los López hacen de su casa un museo para ganar dinero. La vida de una típica familia mexicana promedio. Plácido recupera su taxi que estaba en el corralón.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: Aparecen ante la familia quienes dicen ser los verdaderos padres de Justito. Plácido cuenta cómo se hizo mejor amigo de su jefa millennial.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: Una supervisora visita la casa de los López para saber si la Nena aspira a una plaza como maestra. Para pasar la revisión, la familia debe fingir que son otras personas.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: Justito se da cuenta de que Victoria aparenta ser alguien diferente para agradarle a su novio Bobby. Plácido está decidido a pedirle un aumento de sueldo a su jefa.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: Pierre sale de la cárcel y le pide a la familia López que le ayude a ganar un concurso de modas. Además, Plácido tendrá que entretener a los amigos de su jefa, mientras Justito y Victoria disimulan que el elevador ya funciona.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: Es el cumpleaños de Victoria y de Justito así que los López quieren festejarlos, por lo que deben ingeniárselas, ya que no tienen dinero para hacer la fiesta, hasta que Plutarco llega con una sorpresa en su portafolio.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: Rommy está de regreso y busca a Martina para que lo perdone. Además, ¿permitirán los López que Rommy se lleve lejos a Martina y la aleje para siempre de la familia?

programme.desc: Segunda y última película de la serie El Señor Tormenta compuesta de tres episodios: El Asesino, El Secuestro y la Lucha Final.

programme.title: Historia de un marido infiel
programme.desc: Un hombre estrangula a su esposa paralítica por sus exagerados celos y su amante, que presenció todo, lo extorsiona.

programme.title: Ladrones de niños
programme.desc: Infames ladrones se van al extremo de separar niños de sus madres, con la intención de venderlos por una suma de dinero.

programme.title: Un trío de tres

programme.title: Guantes de Oro
programme.desc: Un vago es entrenado por varios ex campeones de boxeo y en su primera pelea noquea al contrincante con un solo golpe.

programme.title: Las recién casadas
programme.desc: Tres recién casadas de distinto nivel social tienen serios problemas en su matrimonio.

programme.title: Organización criminal
programme.desc: Dos bandas de gánsteres de Chicago rivalizan por el dominio del crimen y a su vez son protegidos por el mismo hampón.

programme.title: ¡Que seas feliz!
programme.desc: Una cantante se enamora de un jugador y se casa con él rechazando a su maestro de canto.

programme.title: La Risa de la Ciudad
programme.desc: Las historias de un grupo de artistas callejeros dejan ver lo difícil que es vivir en la gran ciudad, pero también, sus sueños, metas e ilusiones.

programme.title: Suerte te dé Dios
programme.desc: Dos humildes obreros encuentran monedas de oro en una demolición, pero son despedidos y deben ingeniar una manera de apoderarse del tesoro.

programme.title: Los misterios del hampa
programme.desc: Un gánster es detenido en Chicago, le cuenta sobre su vida a su esposa, pero le pide que le diga a su hijo que fue un empresario.

programme.title: Tiburoneros
programme.desc: Un ambiente de miseria y degeneración donde el humor es enteramente grotesco.

programme.title: Cine
programme.desc: (Drama) Viruta, Capulina.

programme.title: Conozco a los dos
programme.desc: Un hombre mujeriego se lleva a su hija a la capital para evitar que se case con un cantante, pero el joven los sigue.

programme.title: A ritmo de twist
programme.desc: Matusalén es encargado de la tienda de trajes de baño de su tío, junto a su amigo Beto. La competencia les envía a dos hermosas mujeres a espiarlos y robar las ideas y diseños del tío.

programme.title: Duelo en la cañada
programme.desc: Un hacendado defiende a la cantante que ama del tirano que intenta chantajearla con un crimen que ella no cometió.

programme.title: El luchador fenómeno
programme.desc: Resortes se enamora de una bella joven, sin imaginar que un gánster lo meterá en problemas y acabará involucrado en un torneo de lucha libre donde enfrentará a fuertes y ágiles luchadores profesionales.

programme.title: Loquita de amor
programme.desc: Un soldado español regresa a su pueblo después de la I Guerra Mundial y recuerda su vida y amores anteriores.

programme.title: Historia de un amor
programme.desc: Una exitosa cantante recuerda su gran amor por un hombre, y su lucha por alcanzar el nivel de vida que ahora disfruta.

programme.title: En Este Mundo en que Vivimos: Los Fernández de Peralvillo
programme.desc: Un joven fracasa como vendedor de artículos domésticos y su hermana cansada de la pobreza se fuga con un delincuente.

programme.title: Agarrando parejo
programme.desc: Dos ricas herederas les dicen a sus abuelos que están casadas para evitar bodas arregladas, pero todo se complica cuando ellos quieren conocer a los esposos.

programme.title: Misterios de la magia negra
programme.desc: Un profesor quiere investigar los misterios de la magia negra, y empieza a vivir extraños sucesos a su alrededor.

programme.title: Una Estrella y Dos Estrellados
programme.desc: Tin Tan quiere ser estrella, pero es rechazado por los directores de cine, no así por la mujer de la que está enamorado.

programme.title: La loca de la casa
programme.desc: Una monja reevalúa su vida y decide renunciar a sus votos para casarse y ayudar a su padre.

programme.title: Una canción a la Virgen
programme.desc: Una mujer y su hija van a una basílica a pedir que su esposo regrese con ellas y la Virgen les concede el milagro.

programme.desc: Los integrantes de una pandilla se esconden en un convento, donde uno de ellos, herido, recibe ayuda.

programme.desc: Tre and Amanda have been living in a rental for nearly three years, and as the kids get bigger their temporary home is getting smaller. They're ready to find a place of their own and are determined to stay in their exclusive lakefront community.

programme.title: Property Brothers
programme.desc: Along with their two little ones, Rave and Michelle are staying with his parents while hunting for the perfect suburban home. And though they're a close-knit family, living under one roof is proving too close for comfort.

programme.title: Property Brothers
programme.desc: Busy parents Kevin and Shirley desperately want to cut down their daily commute so they can spend more time with their daughters and one another. But they sold the house they loved more quickly than anticipated, and now they're stuck in rental limbo.

programme.title: Property Brothers
programme.desc: With three kids and another one on the way, Dave and Lizzy are desperate to get out of their rental and into the home of their dreams. But they've been house hunting for years already, and their due date is fast approaching.

programme.title: Property Brothers

programme.title: Property Brothers
programme.desc: Since they sold their downtown condo, Leslie and Tim have been living with her parents. And though they both agree it's time to move into a home of their own, she prefers the city while he wants to live in the burbs.

programme.title: Property Brothers
programme.desc: With a baby on the way, Emily and Ken are searching for the perfect suburban home close to family. And since their condo sold more quickly than expected, they're crashing in her sister's basement until they find 'the one'.

programme.title: Property Brothers

programme.title: Property Brothers

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Catching Fire
programme.desc: After arriving safely home from their unprecedented victory in the 74th Annual Hunger Games, Katniss Everdeen (Jennifer Lawrence) and Peeta Mellark (Josh Hutcherson) discover that they must do a quick turnaround and begin a Victors Tour. As she and Peeta travel throughout the districts, Katniss senses a rebellion is stirring. However, President Snow (Donald Sutherland) proves that he is still very much in control when word comes of a cruel change in the rules for the upcoming 75th Hunger Games.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay, Part 1
programme.desc: Following her rescue from the devastating Quarter Quell, Katniss (Jennifer Lawrence) awakes in the complex beneath the supposedly destroyed District 13. Her home, District 12, has been reduced to rubble, and Peeta Mellark (Josh Hutcherson) is now the brainwashed captive of President Snow (Donald Sutherland). At the same time, Katniss also learns about a secret rebellion spreading throughout all of Panem -- a rebellion that will place her at the center of a plot to turn the tables on Snow.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay, Part 2
programme.desc: Realizing the stakes are no longer just for survival, Katniss Everdeen (Jennifer Lawrence) teams up with her closest friends, including Peeta (Josh Hutcherson), Gale (Liam Hemsworth) and Finnick for the ultimate mission. Together, they leave District 13 to liberate the citizens of war-torn Panem and assassinate President Snow, who's obsessed with destroying Katniss. What lies ahead are mortal traps, dangerous enemies and moral choices that will ultimately determine the future of millions.

programme.title: Detroit
programme.desc: In the summer of 1967, rioting and civil unrest starts to tear apart the city of Detroit. Two days later, a report of gunshots prompts the Detroit Police Department, the Michigan State Police and the Michigan Army National Guard to search and seize an annex of the nearby Algiers Motel. Several policemen start to flout procedure by forcefully and viciously interrogating guests to get a confession. By the end of the night, three unarmed men are gunned down while several others are brutally beaten.

programme.title: Kickboxer 3: The Art of War
programme.desc: A Los Angeles martial artist (Sasha Mitchell) goes to Rio de Janeiro and fights to save a girl from a drug lord.

programme.title: Acts of Violence
programme.desc: Three Midwestern brothers, a crime lord, and an incorruptible cop are on a deadly collision course when the youngest brother's fiancée is kidnapped by human traffickers. To save her, the MacGregor boys call on their military training -- and the strength of family -- to fight the most important battle of their lives.

programme.title: Hunter Killer
programme.desc: American submarine Capt. Joe Glass is on the hunt for a U.S. sub in distress in the Arctic Ocean. He soon learns that a secret Russian coup is in the offing, a conspiracy that threatens to dismantle the world order. With crew and country on the line, Glass must assemble an elite group of Navy SEALs to sneak through enemy waters, rescue the kidnapped Russian president and prevent World War III.

programme.title: Line of Duty
programme.desc: A disgraced cop teams up with a livestreaming news broadcaster to try and save the police chief's kidnapped daughter.

programme.title: Seized
programme.desc: A former special forces agent's son is kidnapped and must now wipe out three dangerous crime syndicates, if he wants to see his son alive again.

programme.title: Escape Plan
programme.desc: Tough and chiseled Ray Breslin (Sylvester Stallone) knows how to infiltrate a prison -- and bust out of one. His latest job leads to a double-cross, leaving him stuck in a high-tech facility with the worst that society has to offer. Luckily for Ray, he meets Emil Rottmayer (Arnold Schwarzenegger), an inmate who secretly helps him hatch a plot to win his freedom. Only sadistic warden Hobbes (Jim Caviezel) stands in the way of the two men successfully making it out alive.

programme.title: Escape Plan 2: Hades
programme.desc: Ray Breslin manages an elite team of security specialists trained in the art of breaking people out of the world's most impenetrable prisons. programme.title: Family Feud
programme.desc: Steve Harvey assumes the hosting duties for this daytime game show in which five members of one family are pitted against five members of another family. Each team's goal is to guess the results of audience survey questions. A player from each team initially faces off, answering the question to earn the chance to either pass or play. The winning family gets a chance to earn extra cash in a bonus round.

programme.title: Sssssss
programme.desc: Short on cash, undergrad David Blake (Dirk Benedict) takes a job working as a lab assistant for snake expert Dr. Carl Stoner (Strother Martin). When Stoner begins giving David a series of antibiotics as a safeguard against snakebites, he at first thinks nothing of it. But gradually David begins to notice curious changes in his body, and his new girlfriend, Dr. Stoner's daughter, Kristina (Heather Menzies), notices them too. Could Dr. Stoner really be trying to turn his assistant into a snake?

programme.title: Tarantula
programme.desc: Desert scientists (John Agar, Mara Corday, Leo G. Carroll) try to stop a fortified spider the size of a building.

programme.title: The Thing
programme.desc: In remote Antarctica, a group of American research scientists are disturbed at their base camp by a helicopter shooting at a sled dog. When they take in the dog, it brutally attacks both human beings and canines in the camp, and they discover that the beast can assume the shape of its victims. A resourceful helicopter pilot and the camp doctor lead the camp crew in a desperate, gory battle against the vicious creature before it picks them all off, one by one.

programme.title: Tremors
programme.desc: Repairmen Val McKee (Kevin Bacon) and Earl Bassett (Fred Ward) are tired of their dull lives in the small desert town of Perfection, Nev. But just as the two try to skip town, they happen upon a series of mysterious deaths and a concerned seismologist (Finn Carter) studying unnatural readings below the ground. With the help of an eccentric couple (Reba McEntire, Michael Gross), the group fights for survival against giant, worm-like monsters hungry for human flesh.

programme.title: Tremors II: Aftershocks
programme.desc: After spending all the reward money from his first encounter with the giant man-eating worms called Graboids, Earl Bassett (Fred Ward) agrees to hunt more of the deadly creatures at a Mexican oil refinery for $50,000 each. Knowing that he cannot face the monsters alone, Earl recruits Burt Gummer (Michael Gross), another veteran of the incident in Nevada, to supply the firepower. There is only one problem: The Graboids have now evolved to attack above ground.

programme.title: The Werewolf of London
programme.desc: While in Tibet researching a mysterious flower that purportedly takes its strength from the moon, botanist Wilfred Glendon is bitten by a strange creature. Back in London, Glendon becomes absorbed in his research of the plant, and is annoyed by the appearance of fellow scientist Dr. Yogami, who reveals that the plant is the only known temporary antidote for werewolves. Glendon remains skeptical until the next full moon, when he undergoes a startling transformation.

programme.title: The Wolf Man
programme.desc: When his brother dies, Larry Talbot (Lon Chaney) returns to Wales and reconciles with his father (Claude Rains). While there, he visits an antique shop and, hoping to impress Gwen (Evelyn Ankers), the attractive shopkeeper, buys a silver walking cane. That same night he kills a wolf with it, only to later learn that he actually killed a man (Bela Lugosi). A gypsy (Maria Ouspenskaya) explains that it was her son, a werewolf, that he killed, and that Larry is now one himself.

programme.title: Altered
programme.desc: Forever damaged by their stint as the scientific subjects of hostile alien creatures, a trio of alien-abduction survivors -- Otis (Michael C. Williams), Duke (Brad William Henke) and Cody (Paul McCarthy-Boyington) -- troll the wooded site of their disappearance, heavily armed, in search of their attackers. After wounding a violent alien in the woods, the three drag its dying body to the home of reclusive fellow abductee Wyatt (Adam Kaufman), barricade themselves in and prepare for the worst.

programme.title: Animal
programme.desc: When plans for a weekend vacation hit a dead end, friends find themselves stranded in unfamiliar territory, pursued by a bloodthirsty predator. Holed up in an isolated cabin, the friends must fight to survive as the body count rises.

programme.title: The Atticus Institute
programme.desc: In the early 1970s, Dr. Henry West creates an institute to find people with supernatural abilities. When Judith Winstead comes to the facility, she exhibits amazing abilities that the military wants to turn into a weapon.

programme.title: Beneath
programme.desc: Coal miners become trapped 600 feet below the surface. As the air grows toxic and time runs out, the crew descends into madness and turns on one another.

programme.title: The Birds II: Land's End
programme.desc: Killer birds infest a seaside town where parents (Brad Johnson, Chelsea Field) take their children for vacation.

programme.title: The Black Castle
programme.desc: An Englishman (Richard Greene) enters an Austrian nobleman's (Stephen McNally) castle, complete with torture chamber and alligator moat.

programme.title: Blood Creek
programme.desc: Two brothers become entangled in a sinister Nazi's occult experiment at an American farmhouse.

programme.title: Captive Wild Woman
programme.desc: A mad doctor (John Carradine) turns an animal trainer's (Milburn Stone) ape into Paula the ape-woman (Acquanetta).

programme.title: Cherry Falls
programme.desc: A small-town sheriff, Brent Marken (Michael Biehn), discovers the presence of a serial killer in his sleepy hamlet. Since the perpetrator has been targeting only virgins, both male and female, the deaths cause panic in much of the local high school population. Sheriff Marken's daughter, Jody (Brittany Murphy), is among the potential victims, since she has yet to sleep with her boyfriend, Kenny Ascott (Gabriel Mann). Can the lawman stop the killer before he goes after Jody?

programme.title: Cry Wolf
programme.desc: Mysterious murders occur when students (Lindy Booth, Julian Morris) at a prep school invent a story about a serial killer.

programme.title: Cucuy: The Boogeyman
programme.desc: A teenage girl under house arrest discovers that the nightmarish urban legend of the Mexican boogeyman, El Cucuy, is true.

programme.title: The Darkness
programme.desc: Peter Taylor (Kevin Bacon), his wife Bronny and their two children return to Los Angeles after a fun-filled vacation to the Grand Canyon. Strange events soon start to plague the family, including young son Michael's increasingly erratic behavior. The Taylors learn that Michael brought back some mysterious rocks that he discovered inside a cave. Unfortunately, something followed them home as the clan now find themselves in a battle with a supernatural force that preys on their worst fears.

programme.title: Dead in the Water
programme.desc: An all-female crew, on a boat in the middle of nowhere, must deal with an invader on their ship.

programme.title: Dead Man's Eyes
programme.desc: Blinded by acid thanks to his jealous model, an artist (Lon Chaney) needs eye tissue for an operation.

programme.title: Delirium
programme.desc: A man inherits a haunted house after spending time in a mental institution.

programme.title: Dementia 13
programme.desc: A mysterious masked killer terrorizes members of a family at a secluded estate.

programme.title: The Forest
programme.desc: When her twin sister disappears in Japan, a young American named Sara becomes determined to find out what happened to her. Sara's investigation leads her to the legendary Aokigahara Forest, located at the base of Mount Fuji. Accompanied by expatriate Aiden, she enters the mysterious wilderness after being warned to "stay on the path." Her investigation plunges her into a dark world where the angry and tormented souls of the dead prey on those who dare to explore the forest.

programme.title: Games
programme.desc: Wealthy and bored, Paul (James Caan) and Jennifer Montgomery (Katharine Ross) while away their hours in a New York City apartment filled with pinball machines and other amusements. The couple's routine is upended when door-to-door saleswoman Lisa Schindler (Simone Signoret) drops by and is suddenly taken ill. The Montgomerys let her spend the night. And soon, the sophisticated Lisa and her hosts embark on a new set of very adult -- and very dangerous -- games.

programme.title: Gone
programme.desc: After decades of living on the run, murder suspect Frank O'Neal (Billy Burke) returns to Los Angeles hoping to put his derailed existence back on track. O'Neal reconnects with an old flame, Karen Mellor (Sherry Stringfield), and finds gainful employment as a driver for an armored truck service. But, as he falls under the influence of a maniacal televangelist (Gregory Itzin), the unsavory impulses behind O'Neal's return begin to surface, threatening to destroy him.

programme.title: The Green Inferno
programme.desc: New York college student Justine (Lorenza Izzo), a lawyer's daughter, meets a student activist named Alejandro (Ariel Levy) when he goes on a hunger strike on behalf of underpaid janitors. Smitten, Justine agrees to help Alejandro undertake his next project: to save the Amazon. She soon learns to regret her decision when their plane crashes in the Peruvian jungle and she and the rest of their group are taken captive by a tribe of hungry cannibals.

programme.title: The Guardian
programme.desc: Optimistic about their future, well-off parents Kate (Carey Lowell) and Phil (Dwier Brown) hire the pleasant and lovely young Camilla (Jenny Seagrove) to live with them and care for their new baby. Though Camilla seems like an answer to their prayers, she proves to be more than she appears, and a diabolical plot involving the wellbeing of their child is uncovered. The young parents are forced to fight supernatural forces for the life of their vulnerable offspring.

programme.title: I Saw What You Did
programme.desc: Kit (Sarah Lane) and her best friend, Libby (Andi Garrett), are two teenage girls bored while baby-sitting. To pass the time, they make prank phone calls, telling the person on the other end of the line, "I saw what you did, and I know who you are!" It's all in good fun, until they call a man (John Ireland) who just murdered his wife and buried her in the woods. Convinced they actually do know his secret, he becomes determined to find out who they are and silence them forever.

programme.title: Observing Europe-Europe's heating up: So where is the AC?
programme.desc: CGTN reporter Li Jianhua reports on how Londoners live without air conditioning, despite the British summers getting longer and heater.

programme.title: Observing Europe-So many UK Prime Ministers, same old problems
programme.desc: Since moving to London, CGTN's Li Jianhua has witnessed the UK cycle through four leaders. \nIn this video, Jianhua reflects on the problems facing each of those prime ministers… and why it's affected how he buys grapes.

programme.title: Observing Europe-Who owns Britain?
programme.desc:
One of the first things that surprised CGTN's Li Jianhua after moving to Britain was discovering that London’s iconic black cabs are made by a subsidiary of China’s Geely. 
It’s not alone. Jaguar Land Rover belongs to India’s Tata, Mini is owned by Germany’s BMW, and many of Britain’s airports, utilities and landmark buildings have foreign owners. 
For decades, Britain embraced global investment. But the battle over British Steel suggests attitudes are changing. As concerns grow around national security and economic resilience, the question is no longer just who invests in Britain — but which industries are too strategic to be foreign-owned. 
In this latest episode of his series Observing Europe, Jianhua explores ownership, investment – and where Britain is drawing the line.

programme.title: Observing Europe - Is migration \"weaponized\" in Europe?
programme.desc: Schengen - one of Europe’s greatest achievements - is being tested.\nThe Schengen Area promised border-free travel across much of Europe. But migration, security concerns and increasingly polarized politics are putting that promise under pressure.\nFrom Ceuta to the return of internal border checks, CGTN Europe correspondent Li Jianhua looks at how Europe’s migration debate is reshaping Schengen — and asks: Can Europe keep its internal borders open as political pressure to control migration grows.

programme.title: BizTalk | AI-powered travel reshaping global tourism
programme.desc: China’s tourism market has continued to heat up this summer. Behind this boom, artificial intelligence (AI) is changing how people travel and is opening up new opportunities for the industry – from personalized itineraries to immersive experiences.\n\nIn this episode of BizTalk, guests from the World Economic Forum, the World Travel & Tourism Council and Atout France explore how smart technologies can enhance visitor experiences, optimize destination management and unlock new growth opportunities. They also examine what China's emerging \"AI tourism\" focus could offer the global tourism industry.

programme.title: Global Business-Asian Edition Ep.2
programme.desc: Global Business is the flagship business show of CGTN English Channel, bringing you the latest economic data, business trends and policies.

programme.title: Meet China: When Chinese Dynamism Reshapes Landscapes — Boundless Challenges, Infinite Vitality
programme.desc: In this episode of Meet China, we journey from the cloud-piercing peaks of Zhangjiajie to the tech-driven streets of Shenzhen and the cassava farms of Vietnam. We meet extreme athletes redefining personal limits, turning vertical cliffs and open skies into new playgrounds. Then, we ride in a fully autonomous robotaxi through Shenzhen traffic, exploring the technology and regulations accelerating the global race for self-driving cars. Finally, we travel to Vietnam, where Chinese investment and expertise have transformed the cassava industry—boosting yields, stabilizing farmer incomes, and creating resilient supply chains reaching global markets. From skies to roads to fields, this episode shows how China’s dynamism is reshaping landscapes and lives worldwide.

programme.title: Summer Davos 2026: The Future of Jobs, Skills, and Sustainable Growth
programme.desc:
Global trade is undergoing profound change as economies grapple with shifting supply chains, rapid advances in artificial intelligence, and the transition to cleaner energy.

We are coming to you from the Summer Davos Forum in Dalian, where policymakers, business leaders, and academics from around the world are discussing how to navigate these transformations.

One key question at this year's forum is how these changes will affect workers, and whether they will create new opportunities or deepen existing challenges. To discuss the future of jobs, skills, and sustainable growth, Song Ruixin is joined by Professor Mercedes Maroto-Valer, Deputy Principal for Global Sustainability at Heriot-Watt University, and Kathleen Alexander, co-founder and CEO of Savor, a San Jose based food startup.

programme.title: No Power, No AI
programme.desc: Is energy the ultimate bottleneck for artificial intelligence? As compute demand skyrockets, can our power grids keep up? CGTN's Michael Wang moderates a critical panel at the 2026 Summer Davos Forum on the intersection of AI and energy infrastructure. We'll explore how to align capital investment, infrastructure build-out, and policy frameworks; future-proof energy supply systems to strengthen energy security; and build a more inclusive, sustainable AI-powered energy future. Tune in as global leaders tackle the energy challenge powering the next wave of AI.\n#SummerDavos2026.

programme.title: China Untapped: Suzhou
programme.desc: CGTN’s integrated media cultural and travel program \"China Untapped: Suzhou\" features industrial tourism as its core theme, complemented by Jiangnan cultural tourism. The show follows a narrative thread of a foreign host touring the city alongside an international business investor. Serving as an explorer and guide, host Alex McCutcheon leads the entire industrial tour across Suzhou. UK businessman Athan Fox, acting as a potential investor and observer, views the city through the lens of commercial inspection and identifies the core strengths and investment potential of Suzhou’s high-end manufacturing sector. The production team traveled across Suzhou’s urban districts, Taicang, Kunshan, Changshu and other areas, visiting over 30 enterprises, research institutions and cultural tourism sites. The program presents a perfect blend of robust industrial strength and the exquisite aesthetics of Jiangnan. The two perspectives complement and validate each other, enabling global audiences to learn about Suzhou’s industrial achievements and unique charm in a way that resonates with their cognitive habits.

programme.title: Young Shaolin master
programme.desc: Xu Haican is a kung fu practitioner at the Quanzhou Shaolin Temple in Fujian. The 12-year-old boy is now an expert with the sword, the nine-section chain whip, and the monkey stick after just two years of training. Xu said these weapons give him both confidence and discipline, as he must wield them safely in practice. The young Shaolin master said he hopes to learn more from his masters and carry forward the Chinese martial art.

programme.title: The Datong Motorcycle Diaries
programme.desc: In this Episode, we explore dragon walls in Datong, the City of Dragon Walls, to create a new tourist trail. The host then rides a motorcycle along Datong’s Great Wall, presenting local culture and scenic spots along the way.

programme.title: The Pulse

programme.title: Valentine’s for the Pumi People
programme.desc: In this episode, we record the grand celebration of the traditional Pumi Valentine's Day in Luoguqing, Lanping County, Yunnan Province. Every year, on the fifth day of the fifth lunar month, young men and women from the local community gather on the vast meadows of Luoguqing to take part in singing and dancing activities in pursuit of marriage. During the program, the host interacts with local people of the Pumi and other ethnic groups, showcasing the traditional plateau lifestyle of the Pumi people, their distinctive firepit culture, as well as the community’s brand-new look in the new era. All these scenes unfold against the lively backdrop of the Valentine’s Day activities, fostering a warm atmosphere of ethnic solidarity.

programme.title: Life in the Cloud
programme.desc: The second episode faithfully records what Tianran sees and feels during the backpacking tour in Danba County, Garze Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Sichuan Province. The perseverance, sincerity and hospitality of the people in Xizang leave a profound impression on the travelers visiting this land.

programme.title: Foodwise: Huangshan Ep.1
programme.desc: Tianran and Hannah climb Mount.Huangshan, one of China's most famous mountains, sampling its delicate green tea and the rich flavors of Anhui cuisine, and explore the region's ancient villages and lush bamboo forests featured in the blockbuster film \"Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon\".

programme.title: Foodwise: Huangshan Ep.2
programme.desc: In Huangshan, Anhui Province, the hosts enjoy a cup of Queen Elizabeth II's favorite tea, as well as the oldest green tea to be exported Europe, and get hands on with quirky local delicacies ranging from \"word candy\" and tofu made of leaves, to the downright funky flavors of hairy tofu and stinky mandarin fish.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Wing Chun
programme.desc: Martial arts lover Kleber Battaglia is on a mission: To seek out China's kungfu masters, and learn their secrets. From explosive Wing Chun to fluid Taiji Quan, slippery Snake Style to elegant White Crane, he'll learn hidden moves and ancient techniques for defeating powerful opponents. But ?there’s more to kungfu than combat: From culture and philosophy, to wellness and insights from the natural world, Kleber will discover that contained within every kick, strike and throw, is the condensed wisdom of the ancient masters. This is Kungfu-wise.\nKleber travels to Foshan, the birthplace of Wing Chun. A practitioner of this style, he seeks out masters of two different lineages: Ip Man and Snake Style. First he visits the Ip Man lineage, based on the legendary kungfu master whose life story spawned hundreds of martial arts movies, with Bruce Lee counting among his students. With Ip Man Wing Chun, Kleber learns how to create powerful short strikes perfectly suited to fighting in Foshan’s narrow alleys. With Snake Style, he experiences unique training methods that give its practitioners superhuman flexibility, allowing them to stick to their opponents, and even fight on boats in canals.

programme.title: China Untapped: Nanjing 3
programme.desc: Join us in Nanjing’s bustling old quarter, where you can try on silk dresses worth their weight in gold, and see how traditional handicrafts have been given modern twists. We’ll feast on street snacks and local delicacies by the old Confucian Temple, before taking a pleasure cruise along Nanjing’s mother river to round off our exploration of this vibrant and historic city.

programme.desc: CGTN’s integrated media cultural and travel program \"China Untapped: Suzhou\" features industrial tourism as its core theme, complemented by Jiangnan cultural tourism. The show follows a narrative thread of a foreign host touring the city alongside an international business investor. Serving as an explorer and guide, host Alex McCutcheon leads the entire industrial tour across Suzhou. UK businessman Athan Fox, acting as a potential investor and observer, views the city through the lens of commercial inspection and identifies the core strengths and investment potential of Suzhou’s high-end manufacturing sector. The production team traveled across Suzhou’s urban districts, Taicang, Kunshan, Changshu and other areas, visiting over 30 enterprises, research institutions and cultural tourism sites. The program presents a perfect blend of robust industrial strength and the exquisite aesthetics of Jiangnan. The two perspectives complement and validate each other, enabling global audiences to learn about Suzhou’s industrial achievements and unique charm in a way that resonates with their cognitive habits.

programme.title: Young Shaolin master
programme.desc: Xu Haican is a kung fu practitioner at the Quanzhou Shaolin Temple in Fujian. The 12-year-old boy is now an expert with the sword, the nine-section chain whip, and the monkey stick after just two years of training. Xu said these weapons give him both confidence and discipline, as he must wield them safely in practice. The young Shaolin master said he hopes to learn more from his masters and carry forward the Chinese martial art.

programme.title: The Datong Motorcycle Diaries
programme.desc: In this Episode, we explore dragon walls in Datong, the City of Dragon Walls, to create a new tourist trail. The host then rides a motorcycle along Datong’s Great Wall, presenting local culture and scenic spots along the way.

programme.title: The Pulse
programme.desc: “The Pulse” features musicians performing amidst Guizhou’s stunning natural scenery, bringing to life a harmonious blend of music and landscape.

programme.title: Valentine’s for the Pumi People
programme.desc: In this episode, we record the grand celebration of the traditional Pumi Valentine's Day in Luoguqing, Lanping County, Yunnan Province. Every year, on the fifth day of the fifth lunar month, young men and women from the local community gather on the vast meadows of Luoguqing to take part in singing and dancing activities in pursuit of marriage. During the program, the host interacts with local people of the Pumi and other ethnic groups, showcasing the traditional plateau lifestyle of the Pumi people, their distinctive firepit culture, as well as the community’s brand-new look in the new era. All these scenes unfold against the lively backdrop of the Valentine’s Day activities, fostering a warm atmosphere of ethnic solidarity.

programme.title: Life in the Cloud
programme.desc: The second episode faithfully records what Tianran sees and feels during the backpacking tour in Danba County, Garze Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Sichuan Province. The perseverance, sincerity and hospitality of the people in Xizang leave a profound impression on the travelers visiting this land.

programme.title: Foodwise: Fuding
programme.desc: The hosts are in Fuding, Fujian Province in southeast China for the Dragon Boat Festival, where teams of rowers compete against each other in narrow dragon-shaped boats. From making and eating zongzi rice dumplings to trying local street food, the hosts take part in the festivities before exploring the world of white tea, from visiting its “mother tree” to drinking it in a zen temple, and even feasting on a white tea banquet.

programme.title: Foodwise: Wuyi Mountains
programme.desc: The hosts are in the Wuyi Mountains of Fujian Province, the birthplace of oolong tea. Here they enjoy tea ceremony on a bamboo raft, feast on everything from smoked goose to lotus seed soup, and explore an ancient town that once sold tea to Russia. They discover that here it’s all about terroir, and that nestled within the cliffs of the Wuyi Mountains is the most expensive tea in the world.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Pak Mei
programme.desc: In Foshan, China, Kleber seeks out Liu Weixin, a master of Pak Mei kungfu and on whom the hit game \"Sifu\" was based. He experiences for himself this style's relentless and lightning-fast strikes, but also learns from its master how to balance life and kungfu, how a master should treat his disciples, and what it means to \"eat porridge at night\.

programme.title: China Popcast: All you need to know for traveling in China this summer
programme.desc: Traveling in China for the first time can be a little easier if you know a few things beforehand. In this episode of China Popcast, we tell you which maps to use, how to pay for things, offer advice on how to book tickets for major attractions, share information on China's current travel visa policies and more. Our guests Chen Hongpeng, a Beijing-based tour guide, and CGTN China Travel host Jack Klumpp join the show to give you expert tips for your China trip this summer. And new China Popcast host Min Rui gets the show going with quickfire questions on the \"dos and don'ts.\.

programme.title: Brian Linden: Take me home, country roads
programme.desc: \"Since first arriving in China in 1984, Brian Linden has built a bond with the country that now spans more than four decades. For over 20 years, he has been rooted in Xizhou, a historic town in Yunnan. Drawn by Eastern culture, he arrived as an outsider but gradually became a dedicated rural builder.\nThough he has traveled to more than 120 countries, Linden ultimately chose to settle in rural southwest China. What inspired him to stay, and what China story does he hope to share with the world? Follow Linden’s journey as we explore his life in rural China.\.

programme.title: Ancient tradition in an old town takes on new life
programme.desc: The Chinese lion dance is an art form that combines acrobatics, dance, folk music and embroidery. The southern style lion dance was a staple in the ancient town of Qiantong before the costume faded in the early 20th century. However, now the tradition has been revived by some incredible talented young people from this town.

programme.title: Nature’s Bounty
programme.desc: In this episode, we start from hiking up volcanoes in Datong. There is a large volcanic cluster with over 30 cones. Then we come to the Hanging Temple – a 1,500-year-old monastery clutching at a cliff of Mount Hengshan. Join us for an adrenaline-pumping adventure.

programme.title: Valentine's with the Snake King
programme.desc: Every year on Qixi Festival (Chinese Valentine's Day), the town of Zhanghu in Nanping, Fujian Province hosts a folk custom event: the Snake King Parade. Local residents carry the statue of the Snake King from the temple, along with specially prepared pythons, and parade through the streets and alleys. Wherever the procession passes, residents and shopkeepers greet them with firecrackers and burn incense to pray, hoping to receive the unique blessing of the Snake King. This distinctive folk activity is rarely seen elsewhere across China. Taking this event as its highlight, the episode leads audiences on a deep dive into the towns and villages of northern Fujian, delivering a highly engaging and visually appealing viewing experience.

programme.title: A Magic Chinese New Year
programme.desc: During the Year‑of‑the‑Ox Spring Festival, we visited Gubei Water Town in Miyun District, Beijing. Join host He Tianran to experience an authentic northern‑style Spring Festival. We will paste paper lanterns, cut paper‑cut window decorations, watch sugar‑blowing craftsmanship and release sky lanterns. Let us embrace this blessed Year of the Ox together.

programme.title: Wild Wonders Ep.4
programme.desc: China's vast land features extraordinary geological diversity and climate zones. Home to 5,000 years of civilization and 1.4 billion people, it sustains the world's second-largest economy while sheltering over 2,000 nature reserves. This documentary spotlights China's natural heritage for tomorrow's possibilities.

programme.title: Taohuawu New Year's Painting
programme.desc: Taohuawu New Year woodblock prints, originating from Suzhou, are iconic symbols of Chinese folk art. These vibrant prints, traditionally displayed during Chinese New Year, depict auspicious scenes, deities, and daily life, embodying wishes for prosperity and happiness. Explore the intricate carving and printing techniques that bring these colorful cultural treasures to life.

programme.title: A Sip of Mount Wuyi
programme.desc: Wuyi rock tea, nurtured in the mineral-rich cliffs of the Wuyi Mountains, is a distinctive oolong embodying a unique \"rock rhyme\" (yan yun)—a taste of nature's harmony. More than a beverage, teas like Da Hong Pao invite mindful appreciation, reflecting centuries of tradition and a philosophy of patience in their complex roasted notes and enduring aftertaste. Discover the terroir, meticulous processing, and the spirit of Chinese tea culture within these exceptional leaves.

programme.title: The Dynasty of Oracle Bones Ep.3
programme.desc: Over 3000 years ago, inscriptions were made into the bones of oxen and the undersides of turtle shells for the purpose of divination. Broken down into six comprehensive episodes, this series will enlighten you on the Shang Dynasty when they first appeared, as well as their role in the formation of Chinese writing.

programme.title: A Lifelong Journey of Xuan Paper
programme.desc: The host travels to Jingxian, Anhui—known as the hometown of Xuan paper—to experience the intricate process of making this traditional paper. Along the way, they uncover the secrets behind its thousand-year legacy and witness the craftsmanship of Xuan paper inheritors at every stage. Through vivid, personal stories, the episode reveals the hidden struggles and quiet perseverance that have kept this intangible cultural heritage alive across generations.

programme.title: Dance of Heroes
programme.desc: In this episode, our host “Uncle Hanzi” travels to Chaonan in Shantou to explore the story of a family devoted to the tradition of Yingge dance. Centered around inheritor Hong Shaohua, the story unfolds through his father’s dedication, his daughter’s passion, and his apprentices’ enthusiasm—showcasing how this centuries-old folk art continues to thrive in the modern world.

programme.title: Treasures and Masks Ep.1

Terry Brogan (Bridges), a cynical ex-football star, is hired to find Jessie Wyler (Ward), the runaway mistress of a ruthless L.A. nightclub owner, Jake Wise (James Woods). According to Jake, Jessie had stabbed him and vanished with $50,000. But Terry s mission is soon forgotten when he tracks down and falls in love with the beautiful Jessie on a Mexican island. Trouble brews, however, when Jake dispatches his henchman, Hank Sully (Alex Karras), to bring the lovers back. Driven by passion for the mysterious young woman, Terry quickly finds himself trapped in a complex web of corruption, betrayal,and murder. Packed with riveting excitement and vivid sensuality, AGAINST ALL ODDS grabs you and never lets you go.

programme.title: Why'd They Wear That?
programme.desc: In this episode of Why'd They Wear That?, hosts Clinton Kelly and Stacy London dissect the costumes from Wednesday Season 2, Episode 6, directed by Angela Robinson with costume design by renowned designer Colleen Atwood and Mark Sutherland. The hosts examine Wednesday's striking cold open in bright colors and ombre sweater, critique Larissa's tailoring and fabric choices across multiple looks, discuss the Nevermore school uniform in purple and black, and analyze Gwendoline Christie's character styling. Lady Gaga's brief appearance as a specter generates particular discussion about fabric choices and accessorization. The episode balances appreciation for the show's overall costume work with constructive critique on fit, silhouette, and design decisions.

programme.title: Why'd They Wear That?
programme.desc: Clinton Kelly and Stacy London return to discuss costume design in the three-hour action film "One Battle After Another," exploring eight key looks worn by characters including revolutionary Perfidia Beverly Hills (Teyana Taylor), Bob Ferguson (Leonardo DiCaprio), and other ensemble cast members. The hosts praise costume designer Colleen Atwood's deliberate approach to wardrobe, analyzing how choices like safety orange camouflage, a pregnant character in military gear, and carefully detailed thrift-store aesthetics serve the story without becoming distracting. The conversation examines how costume design can be both detailed and subtly supportive of character development, comparing this film's approach to other cinema styles and discussing how clothing choices communicate character archetypes and backgrounds.

programme.title: Why'd They Wear That?
programme.desc: Clinton Kelly and Stacy London break down the iconic costumes in "When Harry Met Sally," designed by Gloria Gresham. The hosts trace fashion evolution across the film's 12-year timeline, from 1977 collegiate casual wear through early-80s yuppie aesthetics to late-80s power dressing and evening wear. They discuss standout pieces including Sally's navy knee-highs with shorts, the infamous oversized plaid sweater from the orgasm scene, off-shoulder dresses, and bridesmaid gowns. The analysis balances appreciation for authentic period styling with candid critiques of questionable fit and silhouette choices, ultimately celebrating how the costumes authentically capture the era without overshadowing the film's acclaimed dialogue.

programme.title: Why'd They Wear That?
programme.desc: Clinton Kelly and Stacy London break down the costume design of Steel Magnolias, the 1989 Herbert Ross-directed classic that defined 80s Southern fashion. Examining 12 key looks worn by the ensemble cast—including Dolly Parton, Julia Roberts, Sally Field, Olympia Dukakis, and Shirley MacLaine—the hosts praise costume designer Julie Weiss's work while debating which outfits have aged well. They celebrate the film's mastery of pastels, accessories, and hair, though they critique questionable choices like an unflattering bridesmaid dress and one of Julia Roberts's worst wigs. The episode culminates in a discussion of the Easter scene's spring renewal and final ratings.

programme.title: Why'd They Wear That?
programme.desc: Clinton Kelly and Stacy London explore the costume design and fashion choices in Dirty Dancing, the 1987 film set in 1963. They discuss how the opening scenes use wardrobe to establish character contrasts between Baby and her sister, analyze the significance of the "dirty dancing" club scene, and examine Baby's transformation through costume as she becomes involved with dance instructor Johnny. The hosts debate period authenticity, particularly noting anachronistic elements like Penny's disco-influenced styling, and praise how costume design communicates character development and social themes throughout the film.

programme.title: Why'd They Wear That?
programme.desc: Clinton Kelly and Stacy London welcome special guest Carla Hall to examine the costume design of the 1954 musical film Carmen Jones, based on Bizet's opera. The trio analyzes 10 key looks from the film, exploring Dorothy Dandridge's evolution from the seductive factory worker in a red wrap skirt to her glamorous final appearance in a sequined gown. They discuss costume choices that reflect character development, debate whether 1954 silhouettes were used instead of period-appropriate 1940s styles, and examine how accessories either enhance or overwhelm the overall aesthetic. The conversation touches on representation, beauty standards of the era, and what each character's wardrobe reveals about her personality and arc.

programme.title: Why'd They Wear That?
programme.desc: Clinton Kelly and Stacy London dissect the intentional costume choices in The Housemaid, directed by Paul Feig and designed by Renée Ehrlich Kalfus. Through eight awards and superlatives, they explore how the film's palette of cashmere sweaters, scarves, and neutral tones reflects the psychological manipulation at the story's core. From the protagonist's revealing first-day outfit to the terrifying mother-in-law's black-and-white aesthetic, each costume detail reinforces character dynamics. The hosts discuss how fabric choices, color progression, and styling decisions—from vibrant pre-marriage fuchsia to subdued whites and beiges—illustrate the protagonist's loss of agency. They highlight standout looks including a peplum top, funeral attire with snowflake buttons, and an endless supply of luxury cashmere pieces.

programme.title: Why'd They Wear That?
programme.desc: Clinton Kelly and Stacy London dive into the costumes of the 1986 film Pretty in Pink, directed by Howard Deutch with costume design by Marilyn Vance. The episode celebrates how the movie uses vintage and secondhand clothing as a love letter to sustainable fashion, analyzing 12 iconic looks from characters including Andie (Molly Ringwald), Duckie (Jon Cryer), Blane (Andrew McCarthy), and Iona (Annie Potts). The hosts discuss how layering, pattern-mixing, and thrifted pieces create personal style that stands out from mainstream 1980s fashion, while also addressing the film's controversial ending and the infamous final prom dress that nearly every production member disliked.

programme.title: Why'd They Wear That?
programme.desc: Hosts Clinton Kelly and Stacy London examine the costume design of Ang Lee's The Ice Storm, a 1997 film set in 1973 suburban Connecticut during Thanksgiving. Costume designer Carol Oditz dresses the cast in period-accurate polyester, capes, palazzo pants, and crocheted tunics as the characters navigate infidelity and a notorious key party. The hosts break down seven standout looks, from Kevin Kline's oversized collar and dickey to Sigourney Weaver's strategic halter top and beaded necklace at the pivotal party scene. They discuss the film's maximalist 70s aesthetic, the significance of color symbolism, and which characters actually understood the assignment of getting laid.

programme.title: Why'd They Wear That?
programme.desc: Clinton Kelly and Stacy London analyze St. Elmo's Fire, the 1985 ensemble film that inspired a generation. The hosts count down their top five favorite fashion looks from the movie, with three featuring Demi Moore's glamorous character Jules in bold '80s styles including rhinestone details, fur stoles, and statement jewelry. They also identify three of the film's cringiest moments, from Rob Lowe's saxophone scene to the infamous scuba suit sequence.

programme.title: Why'd They Wear That?
programme.desc: In this episode of "Why'd They Wear That?," hosts Clinton Kelly and Stacy London explore the visual style of Tony Scott's 1983 cult classic "The Hunger," featuring Catherine Deneuve and David Bowie as centuries-old vampires. The hosts examine nine distinct fashion moments from the film, analyzing how costume designer Milena Canonero masterfully blends 1940s silhouettes with 1980s sensibilities. They discuss iconic pieces including leather catsuits, garrison caps, oversized blazers, trenches, and statement accessories like an ornate salamander brooch. The conversation highlights how the costumes reveal character, wealth, and sophistication, while exploring the film's enduring influence on fashion and the practical challenges of recreating these looks today.

programme.title: Why'd They Wear That?
programme.desc: Clinton Kelly and Stacy London dive into the wardrobes of Grease's secondary characters, exploring the film's iconic 1950s-inspired costumes. They discuss Stockard Channing's chic black shirt dress as Rizzo, Frenchie's memorable pink hair sequence, the contrast between good girl Patty Simcox and bad girl Cha Cha DiGregorio, and standout prom looks including velvet green dresses and sequined designs. The hosts also reflect on the film's casting of actors in their 30s as high schoolers and debate the merits of Sandy's transformation into "bad Sandy" by film's end, while appreciating costume designer Albert Wolsky's bold color and pattern choices throughout.

programme.title: Why'd They Wear That?
programme.desc: Clinton Kelly and Stacy London dive into six of cinema and television's most distractingly impractical outfits that steal focus from the story. The hosts discuss Milla Jovovich's enigmatic bandage-like ensemble in The Fifth Element designed by Jean Paul Gaultier, Bryce Dallas Howard's high heels while running from a dinosaur in Jurassic World, Blake Lively's haute couture floristry in It Ends with Us, Kerry Washington's signature white coat in Scandal that would never survive a day in Washington D.C., and Kaitlin Olson's impractically short miniskirt at crime scenes in High Potential. Throughout the episode, they explore why costume designers and actors make questionable practical choices and how these wardrobe decisions become more distracting than the actual plot.

programme.title: Simply Symons
programme.desc: In the debut episode of Simply Symons, Michael Symon welcomes viewers into his Venice, California front yard alongside his wife Liz Symon and their friend Olivia Annacone Cisic for an unfiltered, laid-back cookout. Celebrating Cinco de Mayo, Michael prepares simple yet flavorful black cod fish tacos on a plancha, walking through his approach to seasoning, cooking fish by sight, and building a bright, crunchy slaw with cabbage, citrus, and charred poblanos. The conversation flows easily as the trio shares cooking tips, debates ingredients like corn versus flour tortillas, and jokes about knife sharpening habits, cilantro preferences, and home cooking realities. Liz complements the meal with a refreshing jalapeño margarita, balancing heat with fresh lime juice, simple syrup, and a hint of orange liqueur, while adding her own creative twist with lemon and bitters. Throughout the episode, the group emphasizes flexibility in cooking—encouraging viewers to adjust flavors, garnishes, and spice levels to their own tastes. Lighthearted banter continues as they assemble tacos, discuss plating ideas, and highlight optional additions like crema and avocado. The episode wraps with a taste test, enthusiastic reactions to both the tacos and cocktail, and a reminder that great food doesn’t have to be complicated—just fresh, simple, and made with joy.

programme.title: Simply Symons
programme.desc: Michael Symon, Liz Symon, and Olivia Annacone Cisic tackle a brunch-inspired twist on eggs Benedict by swapping traditional Canadian bacon for crispy pastrami and pairing it with a mustard-spiked hollandaise sauce. Michael walks through a foolproof blender hollandaise method while explaining the science behind emulsifying butter and keeping the sauce warm, making the intimidating brunch staple feel approachable for home cooks. As the family cooks together, the conversation bounces between Olivia’s skepticism about poached eggs, Liz’s love of runny yolks, and memories of iconic pastrami spots like Langer’s and Katz’s. The group also debates poaching techniques, from classic whirlpool methods to muffin tin hacks for feeding a crowd. Humor carries the episode throughout as Michael teases Olivia’s picky eating habits and the family jokes about “buttering muffins” and hollandaise disasters. Liz complements the rich brunch dish with a citrus-forward mimosa made from blood oranges, sumo oranges, lemon juice, and frozen strawberries used as flavorful ice cubes. Once plated, the pastrami Benedict wins Olivia over completely, with the crispy pastrami and tangy mustard hollandaise becoming the standout combination. The episode wraps with the family enjoying brunch cocktails, discussing make-ahead egg tips, and Michael reminding viewers that restaurant-quality brunch can come together quickly and simply at home.

programme.title: Simply Symons
programme.desc: Michael Symon kicks off a new era of Simply Symons from Venice, California, joined by Liz Symon and Olivia “Liv” Annacone Cisic for a laid-back backyard cookout centered around the ultimate burger debate: smash burgers versus classic pub burgers. Michael walks through the techniques behind each style, from selecting the ideal fat ratio for ground beef to achieving the perfect crust on a hot grill and cast iron griddle. Along the way, the trio shares stories about old Symon’s Dinners episodes, Liv’s transition into motherhood, and the realities of filming outdoors with planes overhead, lawn equipment buzzing nearby, and neighborhood life unfolding around them. As Michael builds both burgers with grilled onions, pickles, secret sauce, and different cheeses, the conversation turns into a humorous discussion about condiments, cooking preferences, smash burger myths, and burger nostalgia. Liz keeps the energy going with playful jabs at Michael while also preparing his favorite cocktail, the bourbon-based Paper Plane, complete with Aperol, Amaro, and fresh lemon juice. The episode wraps with a tasting session comparing both burgers side-by-side, with everyone weighing in on which version wins the battle. Between the casual banter, cooking tips, and family-style atmosphere, the episode delivers an easygoing and highly approachable backyard burger feast.
